core_obligations: Presentation: choose a scheme U with surjective smooth f : U -> X, set R = U x_X U giving the smooth groupoid presentation X = [U/R] (Algebraic Stacks, Lemma algebraic-lemma-stack-presentation), and the equivalence q_1 : QCoh(U, R, s, t, c) -> QCoh(O_X) (Sheaves on Stacks, Proposition stacks-sheaves-proposition-quasi-coherent) (proof lines 1649-1713).

Construction of q_2: for F in LQCoh^{fbc}, set q_2(F) = (f^*F|_{U_etale}, alpha) where alpha is the composite isomorphism t_{small}^*(f^*F|_{U_etale}) -> ... -> s_{small}^*(f^*F|_{U_etale}) whose outer arrows are the comparison maps; quasi-coherence uses local quasi-coherence and the descent datum uses the flat base change property; the author omits the routine cocycle-condition check (Groupoids in Spaces, Definition spaces-groupoids-definition-groupoid-module); q_2 composed with the inclusion is quasi-inverse to q_1 (proof lines 1649-1713).

Adjunction: define Q = q_1 composed q_2; for F in LQCoh^{fbc} and G in QCoh, Mor_{LQCoh^{fbc}}(i(G), F) = Mor_{QCoh(U,R,s,t,c)}(q_2(i(G)), q_2(F)) = Mor_{QCoh(O_X)}(G, Q(F)), so Q is right adjoint to the inclusion and Q composed with i is the identity (proof lines 1649-1713).
proof_roadmap: Groupoid presentation; descent datum from the flat base change property; adjunction via the equivalences.
difficulty_reason: Construction of Q via a presentation [U/R] and the groupoid module category, adjunction by composition of equivalences. H3: construction-heavy with one routine omitted verification.
